title: AI-IO: An Aerodynamics-Inspired Real-Time Inertial Odometry for Quadrotors
summary: ICRA 2026 paper (arXiv Feb 2026). Argues rotor speed is the missing physical input in learned inertial odometry because rotor drag ties body velocity to measurable quantities, feeds IMU plus rotor speed to a transformer velocity estimator, and fuses its output in an uncertainty-aware EKF. Releases a real quadrotor dataset with IMU, rotor speed and ground truth.
key_takeaways: Abstract: adding rotor speed improves velocity prediction accuracy by 36.9%
Abstract: the transformer adds a further 22.4% over previous results
Code and data MIT-licensed on GitHub

title: DIDO: Deep Inertial Quadrotor Dynamical Odometry
summary: RA-L with IROS 2022 presentation. Uses only onboard inertial and dynamics signals: networks learn IMU bias, a quadrotor dynamics residual and motion state with uncertainty, and a two-stage EKF fuses them.
key_takeaways: Physics-plus-learning pattern: model what you can, learn the residual
Abstract gives no headline number; claims advantage over conventional and learned baselines
Dataset released in the repo, no license file

title: Learned Inertial Odometry for Autonomous Drone Racing
summary: RA-L 2023. IMU-Model Odometry (IMO): an EKF driven by IMU is updated with relative displacements predicted by a temporal convolutional network that also sees thrust (collective rotor) inputs.
key_takeaways: Thrust input is what separates it from pedestrian-style learned IO
Claims better pose than filter- and optimization-based VIO on a racing drone (no number checked here)
Code is GPL-3.0

title: HDVIO2.0: Wind and Disturbance Estimation with Hybrid Dynamics VIO
summary: IEEE T-RO 2025. Extends hybrid-dynamics VIO with rotational dynamics: two TCNs predict residual thrust and torque from commands and gyro history, and the optimizer estimates wind and external disturbances with the full state.
key_takeaways: Abstract reports real flights in winds up to 25 km/h; no accuracy figure in the abstract
Wind is the state that limits model-aided dead reckoning; this estimates it onboard
Code GPL/AGPL, ROS Noetic

title: The Visual-Inertial-Dynamical Multirotor Dataset
summary: Describes a multirotor dataset with camera, IMU, commanded and measured rotor speeds, motor currents, GPS/RTK and mocap ground truth, recorded on a custom platform with hardware time sync. arXiv lists no venue.
key_takeaways: Measured per-motor speed and current, not just commands
Hardware time sync across IMU, camera and motors
Venue not listed on arXiv

title: Learning-based Airflow Inertial Odometry for MAVs using Thermal Anemometers in a GPS and vision denied environment
summary: arXiv preprint (May 2025, no venue listed). Fuses thermal anemometer, IMU, ESC and barometer data with a learned speed estimator for multirotor dead reckoning without GPS or vision.
key_takeaways: Abstract: 5.7 m position drift over a 203 s manual flight, indoors and wind-free
ESC data used as an input, i.e. propulsion as a sensor
Wind-free test, so real-world wind sensitivity is open

title: Tartan IMU: A Light Foundation Model for Inertial Positioning in Robotics
summary: CVPR 2025. Pretrains one inertial model on more than 100 hours of data from four platform types, then adapts per platform with LoRA (1.1 M trainable parameters) and online test-time adaptation.
key_takeaways: Reported 36% ATE improvement over specialized models
Online adaptation reported at 200 FPS
Public release is the LSTM model; the Transformer core is not included per the README

title: Semi-Aerodynamic Model Aided Invariant Kalman Filtering for UAV Full-State Estimation
summary: arXiv preprint. Fixed-wing full-state estimation in a right-invariant error-state EKF fusing IMU, GNSS, magnetometer, barometer, airspeed and control-surface data; an LSTM predicts angle of attack and sideslip from control deflections so only ground-measurable aero parameters are needed. Estimates wind too.
key_takeaways: Abstract: maximum position error stays within 30 m over a 130 s GNSS denial
Code promised (MATLAB/Simulink) but no repository link found
Closest recent fixed-wing aerodynamic-model-aided INS

title: Assessment of VDM-based autonomous navigation of a UAV under operational conditions
summary: Robotics and Autonomous Systems 106 (2018). Replaces the INS process model with a fixed-wing vehicle dynamic model (VDM) and treats IMU, barometer and GNSS as observations, tested on a real small fixed-wing flight and in Monte Carlo simulation.
key_takeaways: Abstract: roughly one to two orders of magnitude better accuracy over 3-minute GNSS outages vs INS-based integration
No extra hardware needed: the model is the added sensor
No public code or flight data found

title: Quadrotors and Accelerometers: State Estimation with an Improved Dynamic Model
summary: IEEE Control Systems Magazine 34(1), 2014. Explains why a multirotor accelerometer measures rotor drag rather than gravity tilt in steady flight, and uses a drag-augmented dynamic model to estimate attitude and velocity from the IMU alone.
key_takeaways: The physics argument behind EKF3/EKF2 drag fusion
Hardware results show better attitude, velocity and position estimates (numbers not checked here)
Open copy on BYU ScholarsArchive

title: Improved State Estimation in Quadrotor MAVs: A Novel Drift-Free Velocity Estimator
summary: IEEE Robotics and Automation Magazine 20(4), 2013. An EKF that uses the blade-flapping drag relation between body-frame acceleration and body-frame velocity to estimate lateral and longitudinal velocity without drift, validated on a commercial quadrotor against Vicon.
key_takeaways: Body-frame velocity becomes observable from the accelerometer alone
Position still drifts with wind and integration
Short, readable derivation to copy into a filter

title: NeuroBEM: Hybrid Aerodynamic Quadrotor Model
summary: RSS 2021. Combines blade-element-momentum theory with a learned residual to model quadrotor forces and torques at speeds up to 65 km/h, and releases the mocap flight data used to fit it.
key_takeaways: First-principles rotor model plus a small learned residual
Data includes per-motor speed at 400 Hz
Basis for the dynamics model in HDVIO

title: NeuroBEM quadrotor flight dataset
summary: About 1 h 15 min of agile quadrotor flights in a Vicon hangar at 400 Hz: filtered linear and angular accelerations, body rates, per-motor speeds and their derivatives, battery voltage, and model-predicted forces. processed_data.zip is 657 MB, raw_data.zip 455 MB (HTTP Content-Length, 2026-11-09).
key_takeaways: Real motor speeds and mocap truth, the input set a drag/thrust virtual sensor needs
Processed accelerations are fused with Vicon, so use raw_data for an honest IMU-only test
No license stated on the page or Readme; ask before commercial reuse

title: Neural-Fly enables rapid learning for agile flight in strong winds
summary: Science Robotics 7 (2022). Learns a wind-invariant basis for the quadrotor aerodynamic residual offline, then adapts a small linear layer online; released flight data covers fan-array winds up to several m/s.
key_takeaways: Aerodynamic residual is learnable and adaptable in flight
Released data has PWM and thrust setpoints at labelled wind speeds
Data and code are personal/educational use only

title: ALFA: A dataset for UAV fault and anomaly detection
summary: International Journal of Robotics Research 40(2-3), 2021. Describes 47 autonomous fixed-wing flights with eight fault types (engine and control surfaces), fault-time ground truth, and evaluation metrics. Data on KiltHub (DOI 10.1184/R1/12707963).
key_takeaways: Real ArduPilot fixed-wing logs with GPS truth
Engine-out segments test a propulsion model's failure mode
KiltHub metadata says CC BY 4.0; bundled README says CC0

title: Fixed-Wing Micro UAV Open Data With Digicam And Raw INS/GNSS - IGN Flight 8
summary: Zenodo record from EPFL TOPO: one fixed-wing micro UAV flight with raw IMU, GNSS and camera data. Single 5.9 GB zip, CC BY 4.0.
key_takeaways: Raw INS/GNSS from a real small fixed-wing, permissive license
Motor and airspeed logging not stated on the record
Same group as the VDM navigation work

title: Aerodynamic modeling of the Skywalker X8 Fixed-Wing Unmanned Aerial Vehicle
summary: ICUAS 2018. Identifies a full aerodynamic coefficient set for the Skywalker X8 flying wing from CFD, wind tunnel and flight data; the model is published in a companion MATLAB repo.
key_takeaways: Ready-made aero coefficients for a common small fixed-wing
Thrust model in the repo is borrowed, not identified
Enough to build a VDM process model in hours

title: Windspeed Estimation and Baro Compensation (ArduCopter)
summary: How to make EKF3 estimate wind on a multicopter without an airspeed sensor by setting ballistic coefficients (EK3_DRAG_BCOEF_X/Y = mass / frontal or side area) and a momentum drag coefficient (EK3_DRAG_MCOEF) from a flight test. Year is approximate; the page carries no date.
key_takeaways: EK3_DRAG_MCOEF is normally 0.1-1.0 per the page
In the EKF3 source (Copter-4.6.3) drag fusion counts as velocity aiding and enables a wind-relative dead-reckoning mode
SITL multicopter frame model in 4.6.3 includes momentum and bluff-body drag

title: Factor Graphs for Navigation Applications: A Tutorial
summary: NAVIGATION (ION journal) 71(3), 2024, open access. Introduces factor graphs as a generalisation of the Kalman filter for navigation engineers, compares EKF, batch and sliding-window estimators on the same problem, and surveys navigation uses.
key_takeaways: Written for people who think in EKFs
Companion Python code compares all three estimators
Good slide source for 'why a factor graph for plug-and-play'

title: Graduated Non-Convexity for Robust Spatial Perception: From Non-Minimal Solvers to Global Outlier Rejection
summary: IEEE RA-L 5(2), 2020. Graduated non-convexity wraps a non-minimal solver to reject outliers without an initial guess; implemented in GTSAM as GncOptimizer.
key_takeaways: Abstract: robust to 70-80% outliers in the tested problems
No global optimality guarantee, but strong empirical robustness
Available off the shelf in GTSAM

title: DEIO: Deep Event Inertial Odometry
summary: Learning-based event-inertial odometry evaluated on 10 public benchmarks against more than 20 methods. The authors' repo labels it ICCV 2025; arXiv lists no venue.
key_takeaways: Learned event front-end plus IMU in a factor graph
MIT-licensed code
Needs event-camera data; no aerial night-flight number checked here
